messages:
mia_cs: Ping — Voltix onboarding hitting 429s during SDK warmup via their proxy. They started 2 hours ago after adding our JS SDK behind an internal proxy. @jordan_eng can you take a look?

jordan_eng: On it. Do we have a sample request/headers + proxy config? Common culprit is preflight fanout + short token TTL.

voltix_oncall: here's a snippet from our logs:

```
2026-03-23T15:12:04Z GET /v1/chat/completions 200ms 429 "{\"error\":\"rate_limit_exceeded\"}" X-RateLimit-Limit: 300 X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0 X-RateLimit-Reset: 163
```

We also use a sidecar that prefetches tokens and re-establishes on 401. SDK init code (simplified):

```js
const {Client} = require('@redwood/sdk');
const c = new Client({key: process.env.RW_KEY, poolSize: 10});
// called per user session on page load
await c.init();
```

mia_cs: note they have ~600 concurrent cold tabs in early access.

lee_devex: two quick questions: are you using ephemeral tokens or the long-lived one? Also what's the client retry/backoff config? Default SDK jitter might be too aggressive for a proxy that caps per-IP.

voltix_oncall: ephemeral tokens, TTL 30s. Retries are default (3 immediate then exponential). Their proxy keeps connections open.

jordan_eng: tl;dr: likely token churn + preflight fanout -> proxy hits per-minute cap. Mitigation steps:
- increase ephemeral TTL to 2-5m for warmup window
- enable jittered splay on client init (randomize init times)
- set SDK to reuse connections and reduce poolSize from 10->3 for initial rollout
- if proxy supports, bump per-ip rate or whitelist backend IPs

Commands for quick test (from customer):
```
# simulate splay: stagger 600 inits over 60s
for i in {1..600}; do sleep $((RANDOM % 2)); node simulate-init.js & done
```

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-23T15:20:10Z: hotfix/ephemeral-ttl-splay merged -> staging

jordan_eng: also enabling server-side token cache (prefix/KV cache) for sessions helps. I'll open a runbook with an easy checklist: change TTL, deploy splay, monitor X-RateLimit-Remaining and 429 spikes, rollback if 5xx increase.

mia_cs: Thanks. I'll coordinate with Voltix PM and schedule a 30m window tonight to apply changes and validate. Feel free to add to runbook any commands.

lee_devex: I'll add a short code patch to the quickstart to recommend TTL >=120s for initial onboarding and a sample splay helper.

voltix_oncall: ack — starting internal patch now, will report back after 30m. Thanks!

mia_cs: great, following up after validation. :thumbsup:
